# AbstractSkill

> The Agent Skills (`SKILL.md`) contract library for AbstractFramework: parse
> and validate skills, discover them on disk with progressive disclosure, hash
> them for evolution and tamper detection, compose their tool declarations with
> an operator grant, and classify their trust. The wheel also ships the curated
> skill registry (14 skills and their trust files), which hosts copy into a
> directory they own with `seed_registry`. Dependency-light (PyYAML only);
> executes nothing, uses no network, and imposes no runtime limits — hosts
> consume its contracts.

"Flows run; skills are activated." AbstractSkill owns the portable skill
contract so `abstractgateway`, `abstractruntime`, and thin clients share
identical semantics without duplicating parsers. `llms-full.txt` holds the
full text of the pages below.

## Core Docs

- [README.md](README.md): overview, the bundled registry and `seed_registry`, quick start, hashing contract.
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): parse, discover, hash, compose tools, evaluate trust, seed the bundled shelf, activate through the trust gate.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): module dependencies, activation data flow, verdict precedence, per-item seeding decision (Mermaid diagrams).
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): every public function and type, including `bundled_registry_dir`, `bundled_registry_version`, `seed_registry` and `SeedReport`.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): common questions and limitations, including what seeding keeps and never deletes.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, diagnostics, and fixes, including kept seed items and manifest errors.

## Key APIs

- `parse_skill_md(text)` → `SkillDocument` (spec-validated; LF/CRLF/CR).
- `FilesystemSkillLoader(roots).discover()/.load(name)` (progressive; loud on broken skills; no trust gate).
- `hash_skill_tree(dir)`, `inspect_skill_dir(dir)` (tamper hash + `has_scripts`).
- `evaluate_trust(registry, tree_hash=..., has_scripts=...)` → `TrustVerdict` (blocked / requires_review / attachable).
- `select_skills_for_context(registry, shelf_root, names)` → `SkillSelection` (the one trust-gated activation pipeline; names-only calls derive sources from the registry).
- `format_available_skills_xml(skills, descriptions=selection.activation_descriptions)` (prompt block).
- `effective_tools(grant, skills)` (grant ∩ declared; never widens).
- `bundled_registry_dir()`, `bundled_registry_version()`, `seed_registry(dest)` → `SeedReport` (adds missing items, refreshes items unchanged since the last seed, keeps everything else with a reason, never deletes; lock `<dest>/.seed.lock`, manifest `<dest>/.seeded.json`).
- `derive_demand(requires=..., inventory=..., granted=...)` → `DemandReport` (informational demand tier; hosts enforce grants).
